```{r lightgbm-recipe}
# lightgbm recipe
airbnb_recipe <- recipe(high_booking ~ ., data = train_split) %>%
    # flag listings with no reviews before imputing scores
    step_mutate(has_reviews = as.factor(ifelse(is.na(reviews_per_month), 0, 1))) %>%
    # Impute first (on original character/nominal columns before encoding)
    step_impute_median(all_numeric_predictors()) %>%
    step_impute_mode(all_nominal_predictors()) %>%
    step_zv(all_predictors()) %>% 
    # Log-transform skewed numerics (offset = 1 to handle zeros)
    step_log(price, minimum_nights, maximum_nights, reviews_per_month,
        host_listings_count,
        price_per_person, amenity_count,
        offset = 1
    ) %>%
    # Keep factors as-is - bonsai passes them to LightGBM as native categoricals
    step_novel(all_nominal_predictors()) %>%
    step_other(property_type, threshold = 0.005)
```


```{r lightgbm-class-imbalance}
# compute class imbalance ratio for scale_pos_weight
tbl <- table(train_clean$high_booking)
pos_weight <- as.numeric(tbl["0"] / tbl["1"])
pos_weight
```


```{r lightgbm-model-spec}
# lightgbm model spec
lightgbm_spec <- boost_tree(
    trees = 1500,
    tree_depth = tune(),
    learn_rate = 0.03,
    min_n = tune(),
    sample_size = tune(),
    stop_iter = 50
) %>%
    set_engine("lightgbm",
        num_leaves       = tune(),
        feature_fraction = tune(),
        counts           = FALSE,
        scale_pos_weight = pos_weight,
        validation       = 0.1,
        lambda_l1        = tune(),
        lambda_l2        = tune(),
        num_threads      = parallel::detectCores()
    ) %>%
    set_mode("classification")

# workflow
lightgbm_wf <- workflow() %>%
    add_recipe(airbnb_recipe) %>%
    add_model(lightgbm_spec)

lightgbm_wf
```

```{r lightgbm-define-params}
# define ranges for engine-level tune() parameters
lgb_params <- extract_parameter_set_dials(lightgbm_wf) %>%
    update(
        tree_depth = dials::tree_depth(range = c(3L, 5L)),
        num_leaves = dials::new_quant_param(
            type      = "integer",
            range     = c(15L, 35L),
            inclusive = c(TRUE, TRUE),
            label     = c(num_leaves = "# Leaves")
        ),
        feature_fraction = dials::new_quant_param(
            type      = "double",
            range     = c(0.5, 0.75),    # force column diversity, prevent near-1
            inclusive = c(TRUE, TRUE),
            label     = c(feature_fraction = "Feature Fraction")
        ),
        sample_size = dials::sample_prop(range = c(0.6, 0.85)),  # cap row subsampling
        lambda_l1 = dials::new_quant_param(
            type      = "double",
            range     = c(-1, 2),        # log10 scale: 10^-1=0.1 to 10^2=100
            inclusive = c(TRUE, TRUE),
            trans     = scales::log10_trans(),
            label     = c(lambda_l1 = "L1 Penalty")
        ),
        lambda_l2 = dials::new_quant_param(
            type      = "double",
            range     = c(-1, 2),        # log10 scale: 10^-1=0.1 to 10^2=100
            inclusive = c(TRUE, TRUE),
            trans     = scales::log10_trans(),
            label     = c(lambda_l2 = "L2 Penalty")
        )
    )
```

```{r lightgbm-cv-folds}
# cross-validation folds on train_split (stratified to handle class imbalance)
set.seed(21)
cv_folds <- vfold_cv(train_split, v = 5, strata = high_booking)
```

```{r lightgbm-tune-hyperparameters}
# tune hyperparameters - optimizing for ROC AUC
tune_results <- tune_bayes(
    lightgbm_wf,
    resamples = cv_folds,
    param_info = lgb_params,
    initial = 10,
    iter = 25,
    metrics = metric_set(roc_auc),
    control = control_bayes(verbose = TRUE, no_improve = 12)
)

# show best results
show_best(tune_results, metric = "roc_auc")

beep(2)
```

```{r}
# 1. Finalize and fit on train_split only
best_params <- select_best(tune_results, metric = "roc_auc")
final_wf <- finalize_workflow(lightgbm_wf, best_params)
final_fit <- fit(final_wf, data = train_split)

beep(3)
```

```{r}
library(patchwork)

combined <- bind_rows(
    train_clean %>% mutate(split = "train"),
    test_clean  %>% mutate(split = "test")
)

# numeric features (by gain order)
num_features <- c(
    "reviews_per_month", "host_listings_count", "amenity_count",
    "latitude_cleansed", "maximum_nights", "host_total_listings_count",
    "longitude_cleansed", "host_response_rate", "price", "price_per_person",
    "minimum_nights", "price_x_bedrooms", "extra_people", "reviews_x_rating",
    "accommodates", "review_scores_value", "review_scores_rating",
    "review_scores_location", "beds", "guests_included",
    "review_scores_accuracy", "review_scores_checkin",
    "review_scores_cleanliness", "bedrooms", "bathrooms",
    "review_scores_communication"
)

# categorical features
cat_features <- c(
    "property_type", "host_response_time", "host_is_superhost",
    "room_type", "instant_bookable", "bed_type"
)

# numeric summary: mean and median for train vs test
num_summary <- map_dfr(num_features, function(f) {
    tibble(
        feature  = f,
        train_mean   = mean(train_clean[[f]], na.rm = TRUE),
        test_mean    = mean(test_clean[[f]],  na.rm = TRUE),
        train_median = median(train_clean[[f]], na.rm = TRUE),
        test_median  = median(test_clean[[f]],  na.rm = TRUE),
        mean_pct_diff = abs(train_mean - test_mean) / (abs(train_mean) + 1e-6) * 100
    )
}) %>% arrange(desc(mean_pct_diff))

print(num_summary, n = 30, width = Inf)

# categorical summary: proportion of most common level
cat_summary <- map_dfr(cat_features, function(f) {
    tr <- table(train_clean[[f]]) / sum(!is.na(train_clean[[f]]))
    te <- table(test_clean[[f]])  / sum(!is.na(test_clean[[f]]))
    all_levels <- union(names(tr), names(te))
    tibble(
        feature = f,
        level   = all_levels,
        train_prop = as.numeric(tr[all_levels]),
        test_prop  = as.numeric(te[all_levels])
    ) %>% mutate(
        train_prop = replace_na(train_prop, 0),
        test_prop  = replace_na(test_prop, 0),
        abs_diff   = abs(train_prop - test_prop)
    )
}) %>% arrange(desc(abs_diff))

print(cat_summary, n = Inf, width = Inf)
```
